title: Bodhisattva Path
speaker: Shuko Edie Norton
summary: The talk emphasizes the importance of being present and fully engaged with one's experience, rather than relying on external rituals or practices to bring about spiritual growth. Shuko Edie Norton suggests that by letting go of attachments to specific traditions or formulas, one can tap into a deeper sense of awareness and understanding. This approach encourages individuals to cultivate a sense of "being" in the moment, unencumbered by expectations or distractions. By doing so, they may discover a more authentic and profound connection with themselves and the world around them.
